requirements.A: fields are stripped of surrounding whitespace and mapped in order
requirements.B: a blank or whitespace-only field is None, not an empty string

blank_stays_empty_string.why: stripped the fields but left a blank one as an empty string

only_empty_counts_as_blank.why: treated the empty string as blank but not a whitespace-only field
